name: a vague craving typed into a chat input
looks: A phone screen holds a chat input field with a half-written message already filled in, trailing off mid-word, a blinking text cursor sitting inside the highlighted last letter as if caught mid-type.
build: DOM text revealed with kit.typeOn up to a paused point; the cursor blinks on the beat at the live character position; the send button sits ready, unpressed, to carry tension into the next beat.
sound: A soft key tick under the typing, holding on silence at the pause.
prompt: Hold on a phone's chat input with a vague, half-written request typed in and trailing off mid-word, a blinking cursor caught at the last letter, so the viewer feels the uncertainty before the system responds.
